query: What recurring issues drive resolution inefficiency?

per_column.name: issue_category_primary
per_column.rationale: The type/category of the underlying issue (printer, hardware, software, connectivity) is a constitutive aspect OF what the recurring issue is -- it answers 'what kind of issue' as a part of the reason space.

per_column.name: specific_issue_mechanism
per_column.rationale: The specific failure mechanism (display_malfunction, paper_jam, network_outage) is a finer-grained aspect OF the issue itself, describing the concrete nature of the recurring problem.

per_column.name: issue_recurrence_pattern
per_column.rationale: Recurrence pattern (repeated_device_type, systemic_pattern, single_mention) is an aspect OF the 'recurring' dimension of the reason -- it characterizes how the issue repeats, a constitutive facet of a recurring-issue concept.

per_column.name: diagnostic_clarity
per_column.rationale: Whether the issue was clearly diagnosed is a property of the handling/resolution process, not a part OF the issue reason itself. It is an external factor affecting inefficiency rather than a constitutive aspect of the issue.

per_column.name: assigned_technician_proxy
per_column.rationale: The identity of the assigned technician is a handler attribute (already largely present as assigned_to), not an aspect OF the issue reason. It is an external actor, not a facet of the concept, and risks being a restatement of existing columns.

judge.rationale: Three of the five columns are genuine facets of the recurring-issue concept: category (what type), mechanism (specific failure mode), and recurrence pattern (how it repeats). However, issue_category_primary and specific_issue_mechanism substantially overlap -- the mechanism values (display_malfunction, paper_jam, network_outage) are essentially finer instances of the same category dimension, so they carve largely the same aspect at two granularities, lowering mutual exclusivity. diagnostic_clarity is a process/handling attribute (external predictor of inefficiency) rather than a part of the issue reason, and assigned_technician_proxy is an external actor that restates an existing table column, so neither is constitutive. Exhaustiveness is moderate: the set captures the 'what/how' of issues but leaves out other constitutive aspects of inefficiency reasons such as knowledge/resource gaps, process/handoff friction, or root-cause layer, and the two non-facets consume slots without covering the concept.
